seoDescription: Suggest a topic and explore ways to collaborate on open data, legislation and open government in Kazakhstan. The community is being formed.

hero.title: Let's discuss how to make government more open
hero.p1: We want to bring together citizens and experts who care about understanding government decisions and taking part in discussions about them.
hero.p2: If you have a question, experience or an idea about developing open government in Kazakhstan, suggest a topic for collaborative work.

why.title: Why work together
why.p1: Understanding a government budget may require an economist's expertise. Assessing a draft legal act may call for a lawyer and the people it would affect. Building a service using open data may require a researcher and a developer.
why.p2: Sharing knowledge helps frame questions more precisely, verify conclusions and prepare well-founded proposals.

audiences.title: Who might be interested
items: Citizens and civil society organizations — raise an issue affecting people.
Journalists and researchers — discuss sources, data and analytical methods.
Lawyers and public administration specialists — assess legal provisions and propose changes.
Analysts and developers — explore data and opportunities to build services.
Writers and educators — explain complex topics in accessible language.

areas.title: Possible areas of collaboration

items.title: Open data and government portals
items.text: Study data availability, assess portal usability and suggest improvements.

items.title: Legislation and civic participation
items.text: Discuss regulatory decisions and prepare proposals for greater transparency and accountability.

items.title: Public-interest services
items.text: Identify problems that could be addressed with open data and software.

items.title: Materials and events
items.text: Prepare explanatory publications, discussions, educational meetups and hackathons.

areas.note: These are potential directions for future work. The community is still being formed.

start.title: Where to start
start.p1: Tell us which topic interests you, what question you suggest exploring and how you could contribute. Include links to data, documents or examples if you have them.
start.p2: You do not need a ready-made solution to suggest a topic.
